title: The Locker of Route 9
author: Hazel Dunmore
blurb: Emrys Sterling, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
